provenance.description: Immutable source, definition hashes and pack/slot snapshots. Legacy reconstruction explicitly marks unknown historical fields.

params.description: Public bounded parameters for a server-installed handler; never source code or credentials.

type.description: Built-in type or declared namespaced custom type.

metadataSchemas.description: Bounded local schema subset for card metadata, variant metadata and stats; no external refs, regex or executable tags.

probability.description: Numerator cannot exceed denominator. One draw per slot, not per card.

adminRevision.description: Administration revision from the reviewed quote. Stale prices or odds require a new quote.
